column1: # HTML content-model facts: a machine-readable projection of the WHATWG HTML
# Living Standard, the single source the vize HTML conformance checker reads
# (`vize_patina::html_content_model`). Every row names the spec clause it
# projects; the checker's verdicts over it are pinned against an independent
# GENERATED from the snapshot excerpt in `whatwg/` — do not edit by hand:
#   set       an element set named by the tree-construction algorithm (§13.2)
#   category  a content category (§3.2.5.2, index "List of element content categories")
#   children  an element's content model (index "List of elements", Children column)
#   tag            an HTML-namespace element, ASCII lowercase
#   tag?cond       conditional membership; cond is an attribute predicate the
#                  checker evaluates three-valued (dynamic bindings are unknown)
#   @category      every member of that category row
#   #text          text that is not inter-element whitespace
# Every row is referenced by name from the checker; the checker's loader
# rejects unknown kinds, unknown names, duplicate rows and missing rows.
